Hypothesis B uses a homogenization treatment that is unlikely to significantly raise strength at 1273 K in this already single-phase BCC alloy, and its cited evidence concerns a different alloy (HfMoNbTaW) at 1600°C, making the mechanism and predicted outcome poorly grounded for TiVNbTa.
